semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in inspection devices for measuring film thickness, which is critical in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: JFE Techno-Research develops advanced inspection devices that measure the two-dimensional distribution of film thickness on various substrates, including silicon wafers. Their technology enhances yield improvement and quality control in semiconductor manufacturing by providing high-resolution and accurate measurements of thin films.
capabilities: Two-dimensional spectroscopic interference film thickness gauge
Imaging spectrometers for optical spectrum measurement
High-speed measurement devices for thin films
